## Forbidden formulations (sections 6/18) checked against the same fact set
- missedCount = unrecordedCount would report 1 'missed' doses: FORBIDDEN (no recorded intake does not mean not taken)
- the forbidden occurrence-coverage ratio is matched occurrences / (matched + unrecorded) occurrences = 6 / (6 + 1) = 85.7%: FORBIDDEN (it reads as 'how much of what was prescribed was taken', while the denominator is generated from the CURRENT plan).
  Note: this is NOT 'all recorded authoritative intakes' - unmatched intakes (3) are not occurrence coverage at all.
- unmatched intakes (3) must stay out of any plan-based denominator while still counting as recorded intakes
